import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import ts from 'typescript';
import { PathTooLongError } from '../errors/vision-forge-error.ts';
import { canonicalJson } from './canonical-json.ts';
import type { JsonValue } from '../shared/canonical-json.ts';

/** Uses every import. */
export function describe(value: JsonValue): string {
  const text = canonicalJson(value);
  if (text.length > 240) throw new PathTooLongError(text, 240);
  return `${readFileSync(text, 'utf8')} ${ts.version}`;
}
